XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS AI Quiz (Phase G.1 scaffold) — single audit table tracking each generation attempt. The plugin records what was requested (hashed prompt + model + language) and what came back (tokens + success flag + error code) so that future cost analytics can compute per-customer + per-user daily spend without leaking source text or prompt content. prompt_hash is SHA-256 of (prompt template || source text) so two identical requests collide; the source text itself is never persisted by this plugin.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_ai_quiz_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Phase G.1 (2026-05-24) — One row per generate_quiz() invocation. Records request metadata + outcome for cost analytics and audit, without retaining the source text or full prompt body. The Phase G.1 scaffold never inserts a live row (anthropic_client throws confirm_required before any persistence). The table exists so the live-wiring chip can land additively.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — caller of generate_quiz().

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to course.id — 0 for site-level / not yet assigned.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope (1 = Airpay customer-zero in Phase 1).

FIELD.NAME: prompt_hash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hex digest of (prompt_template || source_text). Constant length 64.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_in
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic input_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_out
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic output_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: success
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = call succeeded and parser yielded N >= 1 questions; 0 = failed/blocked.

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Short failure detail on success=0 (never include API key, never include source text).

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_created
INDEX.COMMENT: Per-user spend over a window — daily cap enforcement.
